objective: Create a strict composite routing identity for AIWorkingHub so callbacks and mux state cannot cross repositories even when thread IDs or task IDs collide.

acceptance_results.composite_key_construction: PASS — RepoRouteKey(repo_id, thread_id, task_id[, event_id]) immutable frozen dataclass
acceptance_results.field_validation_rejects_all: PASS — empty repo/thread/task, path separators, backslash, control chars, non-ASCII, spaces, excessive length, zero-width, bidi overrides, non-string types all raise ValueError
acceptance_results.canonical_serialization: PASS — deterministic 'repo:thread:task:event' form, round-trip via parse()
acceptance_results.digest_deterministic: PASS — SHA-256 hex digest matches manual hash, 32-char short and 64-char full
acceptance_results.cross_repo_disjointness: PASS — same (thread, task, event) in two repos → different equality, hash, digest, canonical; same repo diff thread/task/event also disjoint
acceptance_results.idempotency: PASS — identical composite keys equal, same hash, set membership 1, dict key overwrite
acceptance_results.legacy_thread_only_fail_closed: PASS — fail_on_legacy_thread_only() raises ValueError when repo_id or task_id missing; succeeds when all present
acceptance_results.dict_json_round_trip: PASS — as_dict() → from_dict() identity preserved; JSON serializable
acceptance_results.client_message_id_repo_scoped: PASS — to_client_user_message_id() differs per repo; 'cbmsg_' prefix + 32 hex chars
acceptance_results.repo_scoped_path_within: PASS — valid key resolves within repo_base, exists on disk
acceptance_results.repo_scoped_path_escape_rejected: PASS — parent traversal, absolute path, drive letter, null byte, dot segment, empty key, symlink escape all raise ValueError
acceptance_results.safe_repr_no_abs_path: PASS — <repo_root>/relative/path form never exposes absolute filesystem path
acceptance_results.forbidden_compliance: PASS — no callback_delivery_mutation, no mux_registry_mutation, no thread_only_fallback, no cross_repo_route_guessing, no secret_logging

design_notes.repo_id_scoping: All routing keys embed repo_id as the first field. Two repos with colliding thread/task/event tuples produce disjoint keys at every level: equality, hash, canonical string, digest.
design_notes.validation_fail_closed: Every field is validated by explicit length/character rules. Missing repo_id, path separators, controls, Unicode confusables (zero-width, bidi marks, private use, non-ASCII) all raise ValueError — never guessed, never silently truncated.
design_notes.path_containment: repo_scoped_path() resolves and checks containment via Path.relative_to(); rejects '..', absolute paths, drive letters, null bytes, dot segments, empty keys, and symlink escapes.
design_notes.safe_repr: repo_scoped_safe_repr() uses the literal placeholder '<repo_root>/' — absolute filesystem paths are never exposed in callback/owner text.
design_notes.legacy_bridge: to_legacy_dedup_key() produces (task_id:transition:thread_id:episode_id) for compatibility with the existing outbox schema. to_client_user_message_id() includes repo_id for cross-repo safety.
